veranderings.voor: Iets wat in die donker lig terugkaats, help 'n bestuurder om jou te sien.
veranderings.na: Iets wat lig terugkaats, help 'n bestuurder om jou in die donker te sien.
veranderings.rede: 'in die donker lig' can be misread as 'the dark light'; moving 'in die donker' to the seeing keeps the meaning and removes the ambiguity.
'die hand' is wooden in an instruction addressed to 'jy'; 'jou hand' is the natural form and changes nothing in the rule.

The lesson uses 'oorsteek' for crossing everywhere else ('oorstap' suggests changing over); the comma closes the subordinate clause before 'en' joins a second instruction, as in the bicycle block's 'voordat jy draai, en sit'.
